card.name: Openings of parenthetical notes in interaction text
card.fires_on: Punctuation and short pieces right before a clarifying note in drug-interaction and exposure text, such as an opening parenthesis after a drug name, the digit in CYP2D6, or the start of 'Dosage' after 'see'.

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug or term
modes.description: An opening bracket after a drug or measurement name that introduces a note such as a substrate type or abbreviation.
modes.example: the C max and AUC of dextromethorphan<< (>>CYP2D6 substrate) were

modes.label: Partway through cross-reference or enzyme name
modes.description: A piece inside 'Dosage' after 'see' or inside enzyme names like CYP2D6.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank or spacing piece just before a dose or ratio value in interaction text.
modes.example: Co-administration of avacopan and<< >>40 mg simvastatin increases
